author: GamingBolt
description:
Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! is a brand new retro-styled shooter from the studio behind Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Rather than the latter’s approach to combat and level design, however, Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! takes a more unique approach to its gameplay by mixing in classic shooter mechanics with more modern level design that encourages exploration by tossing you into a large, open map with a number of different objectives to tackle. 

The moment-to-moment gameplay of Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! is incredibly fun, with the bugs offering a great challenge thanks to their sheer numbers, as well as variety. 

The missions themselves can often revolve around anything from surviving massive hordes to protecting a base, and even discreetly planting bombs under larger bugs. title: Starship Troopers Ultimate Bug War Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert is nearly here, and if you're like us, you're probably clearing your calendar and cancelling those pesky weekend plans for a game that's been a long time coming. 

You're probably going to like this one if that's the case, as we dive into why it takes the best features from the best open world games in its effort to achieve ambitions that are as sky-high as the hype it managed to generate. 

It's a risky business but it's also an opportunity for this one to be a game that we talk about for a long time after we roll the credits on the grand adventure it’s bringing to the table. Join us as we show you how it aims to imitate some of the best open worlds (10 of them!) out there in its effort to be one that joins their illustrious ranks all on its own merits.
title: Crimson Desert - A Game That Does Everything
